Date: 2026-08-19
Tail-Risk Brief v2.0 — Morning Desk Section (pre-market America/Chicago)

# Section 0: Current Positions & Hypotheses

As of August 19, 2026 (pre-market, ~8:30 AM CT). Research framework, not trade recommendations.

**Book snapshot (default ••••770):** Cash 95.5% · net delta -13.0% (net short) · gross delta leverage 1.41× · premium at risk 16.1% · theta -0.16%/day. All positions live on the default account; agentic account remains empty.
**Model risk appetite:** Last reading GPT 6/10 (Risk-on) · Grok 4/10 (Neutral) · Fable 8/10 (Risk-on). Today's engine refresh pending (grok-risk-daily runs separately).
**Overnight book flip:** BRBR 500 sh and WAY 300 sh equities are gone; the book is now options-led longs (CTVA catalyst, FRMI/BRBR deep-dated calls, AAON equity) plus a protected short book — DASH and LYV short 50 sh each with long Jan '27 puts, and a 1-sh TOST short. DJT joined the trackers. Net delta flipped negative.

## 1. CTVA — seed & crop-protection, split catalyst (new, options-led)

**Price:** $77.91 close / $78.45 pre-market (+0.7%) | RSI(14): 43.5 | MACD histogram: -0.44
**Valuation:** Market cap $52.0B | PE 50.3× | P/B 2.0× | Div yield 0.9% | 52w range $60.54–$90.97 (high Jul 29)
**Entry levels (52W low / Aug 18 market ref / 52W high):** Bear $60.56 | Base $78.07 | Bull $90.51
**Thesis:** Seed pricing and crop-protection productivity into the September investor days and October Vylor spin — two investable companies without operational disruption or stranded costs.
**Holdings:** 50× Sep 18 '26 $85 calls @ $0.385 (mark $0.425, IV 23.3%, delta 0.16, break-even $85.43) + 1 sh tracker @ $77.79. Largest exposure in the desk book (52% of exposure per desk model).
**Latest:** UBS raised profit forecasts ahead of the split (Aug 18); BlackRock reported buying 53.8M shares; Danske Bank disclosed a new stake (Aug 19); Yahoo Finance piece argues 32% undervalued after debt exchange offers.
**Catalyst:** September investor days + October Vylor spin (per thesis) · ex-div Sep 1 · **option expiry Sep 18 — 30 DTE, theta now the clock**
**Kill watch:** Price pinned at base $78.07; RSI 43.5 neutral. Ref R/R is the worst in the long book (0.7×) — the position lives or dies on the spin catalyst landing inside 30 days, not on drift.
**Action:** Hold — catalyst-driven; the Sep $85s need a move; treat $75 as the add/exit decision line.

![CTVA RSI](charts/2026-08-19/ctva-rsi.png)

![CTVA MACD](charts/2026-08-19/ctva-macd.png)

## 2. FRMI — development-stage AI infrastructure (hold, high-conviction risk)

**Price:** $5.74 close / $5.77 pre-market (+0.5%) | RSI(14): 43.0 | MACD histogram: ~0.00 (flat-lined)
**Valuation:** Market cap $3.68B | P/B 3.8× | Pre-revenue | 52w range $4.47–$36.99
**Entry levels (52W low / cost basis / call-strike refs):** Bear $4.47 | Base $7.26 | Bull $15.00
**Thesis:** Project Matador becoming a scarce, gigawatt-scale powered AI campus near Amarillo. Commercial agreements and funded delivery — not headline capacity — must validate it.
**Holdings:** 500 sh @ $6.56 (-12%) + 10× Dec '28 $10 calls @ $3.676 (mark $2.60, -12% d/d, IV 98.9%, delta 0.68, break-even $12.60).
**Latest:** Site advancing per Amarillo Globe-News (Apr); $200M equipment facility initial draw (Feb); water-efficient cooling claims (Jun). No new commercial announcements this week — IV crush is doing the damage to the calls.
**Catalyst:** Funded customer/power agreements TBD; construction milestones.
**Kill watch:** Price 21% below base $7.26; bear ref $4.47 is -23%. MACD momentum has gone quiet after last week's flip. RSI 43 = drifting, not breaking down.
**Action:** Hold — binary thesis unchanged; call marks are IV-driven noise until a catalyst or breach of $4.47.

![FRMI RSI](charts/2026-08-19/frmi-rsi.png)

![FRMI MACD](charts/2026-08-19/frmi-macd.png)

## 3. AAON — data-center cooling (hold, post-earnings drift)

**Price:** $82.06 close / $83.25 pre-market (+1.4%) | RSI(14): 32.0 | MACD histogram: +0.22
**Valuation:** Market cap $6.77B | PE 42.9× | Div yield 0.5% | 52w range $73.19–$150.46
**Entry levels (52W low / Aug 13 close / 52W high):** Bear $71.77 | Base $87.67 | Bull $148.15
**Thesis:** BASX cooling demand and $2.0B record backlog must convert into revenue, gross-margin recovery, and cash faster than Memphis overhead ramps.
**Holdings:** 50 sh @ $88.12 (-6.9%)
**Latest:** Q2 earnings-call highlights confirm record sales (Aug 17); simplywall.st still flags margin-reset risk after +101% revenue growth (Aug 11); IBD notes AI data-center expansion into North Dakota (Jun 26).
**Catalyst:** Q3 earnings — Nov 5, 2026 am (unconfirmed) · ex-div Sep 4
**Kill watch:** Most oversold chart in the book (RSI 32) yet MACD histogram is positive — rare divergence; pre-market bounce +1.4%. Kill: price below $73 (52W low) or backlog conversion stalling.
**Action:** Hold — beat confirmed demand; the drift is digestion, not rejection, while MACD stays positive.

![AAON RSI](charts/2026-08-19/aaon-rsi.png)

![AAON MACD](charts/2026-08-19/aaon-macd.png)

## 4. BRBR — branded protein (hold via calls only)

**Price:** $10.38 close / ~$10.40 pre-market (+0.2%, wide market) | RSI(14): 35.0 | MACD histogram: -0.29
**Valuation:** Market cap $1.21B | PE 7.2× (depressed earnings) | 52w range $7.82–$43.02
**Entry levels (1Y low / Aug 12 close / 1Y high):** Bear $7.90 | Base $10.85 | Bull $42.68
**Thesis:** Company-specific margin recovery, not a generic GLP-1 play. Pricing/productivity must restore margin without breaking demand.
**Holdings:** 3× Jan '28 $12.50 calls @ $3.80 (mark $3.15, -7.4% d/d, IV 72.9%, delta 0.62, break-even $15.65). Equity leg closed overnight.
**Latest:** BofA disclosed acquiring 250,144 shares (Aug 19); Ameriprise 5.0% ownership with shared control (Aug 14); margin-squeeze narrative persists (simplywall.st, Aug 4).
**Catalyst:** FQ4 earnings — est. Nov 17, 2026 (unconfirmed)
**Kill watch:** Price 4.5% below base $10.85; RSI 35 near book-weakest; call mark bleeding with IV. Kill: volumes decelerating alongside failed margin recapture.
**Action:** Hold — deep-dated calls keep the asymmetry; no equity means margin-recovery evidence is the only thing that pays.

![BRBR RSI](charts/2026-08-19/brbr-rsi.png)

![BRBR MACD](charts/2026-08-19/brbr-macd.png)

## 5. LYV — live-events cycle (new short, put-protected)

**Price:** $179.84 close / wide pre-market ($177.84×$183.25) | RSI(14): 46.9 | MACD histogram: -0.31
**Valuation:** Market cap $42.4B | PE n/m (loss) | 52w range $125.34–$189.25 (high hit Aug 14 — fresh)
**Entry levels (52W low / Aug 18 ref / 52W high):** Bear $125.61 | Base $180.74 | Bull $188.46
**Thesis (short):** Record ticket sales (143M+ through mid-July) have run the stock to a 52-week high; the position bets demand normalization and legal/capital intensity catch up before deferred revenue converts.
**Holdings:** Short 50 sh @ $181.62 + 6× Jan '27 $165 puts @ $6.233 (mark $6.35, IV 31.2%, delta -0.26, break-even $158.65)
**Latest:** Zacks raised to Hold (Aug 19); StockStory lists LYV among "inflated stocks walking a fine line" (Aug 19); Q2 lift + 8%-undervalued case from simplywall.st (Aug 13). Sides genuinely split at the highs.
**Catalyst:** Q3 earnings — early Nov (unconfirmed)
**Kill watch (short risk):** Stock sits 4.7% under the fresh 52W high — squeeze territory is tight and defined: $188.46. Downside ref $125.61 is +31% for the short. RSI 46.9 = momentum cooling, MACD negative.
**Action:** Hold — protection caps the disaster case; let the put strike define the fight ($165–188 zone).

![LYV RSI](charts/2026-08-19/lyv-rsi.png)

![LYV MACD](charts/2026-08-19/lyv-macd.png)

## 6. DASH — local-commerce multiple (new short, put-protected)

**Price:** $216.35 close / $216.00 pre-market (-0.2%) | RSI(14): 65.3 | MACD histogram: +0.56
**Valuation:** Market cap $93.7B | PE 113.6× | 52w range $143.30–$285.50
**Entry levels (52W low / Aug 18 ref / 52W high):** Bear $146.60 | Base $215.79 | Bull $281.74
**Thesis (short):** Q2 revenue beat is digested; the position bets 113× earnings prices in perfection while regulation, insurance, and autonomy spend compress margins.
**Holdings:** Short 50 sh @ $220.04 + 5× Jan '27 $200 puts @ $14.40 (mark $15.15, +5.2% d/d, IV 45.4%, delta -0.32, break-even $184.85)
**Latest:** Zacks upgraded to Hold (Aug 19); "revenue beat + fresh bullish analyst targets" tape (Aug 18); Gap back-to-school partnership live.
**Catalyst:** Q3 earnings — early Nov (unconfirmed)
**Kill watch (short risk):** Strongest momentum chart in the whole book (RSI 65, MACD +0.56) — this is the squeeze candidate Gemini flags first. Upside ref $281.74 = -28% against the short; $200 put strike is the hard floor of the structure.
**Action:** Hold — short thesis is a multiple reset, not a break; respect the momentum, size is the hedge.

![DASH RSI](charts/2026-08-19/dash-rsi.png)

![DASH MACD](charts/2026-08-19/dash-macd.png)

## Mini-book (trackers, shorts, watch)

- **TOST** — short 1 sh @ $35.49 (close $34.95, pre $34.97, flat). Token restaurant-OS short; 52w $22.26–$45.64; PE 44.7×.
- **DJT** — 1 sh @ $8.07 (new tracker, onboarded Aug 18). Pre $8.13. Event-driven media/digital-asset position pending TAE merger; refs $7.06 / $8.06 / $18.50.
- **BOT** — 1 sh @ $32.67. Pre-market $30.48 vs $28.41 close — +7.3% overnight print on no news; premium-to-NAV risk is the whole story. Aug 30 NAV checkpoint.
- **HIMS** — 1 sh @ $28.73, pre $27.59 (+0.7%).
- **FIGR** — 1 sh @ $35.00, pre ~$35.69.
- **OSCR** — 1 sh @ $31.34, pre $30.79 (-1.6%). Pullback from the Aug 14 high; momentum intact.
- **Closed/gone from book:** BRBR & WAY equities (overnight), NKE tracker (was below bear ref — Sep 8 checkpoint moot), URNM.
- **Watch only:** MOS $21.33 pre (+0.9%; refs $19.82/$22.60/$31.04) · XLE energy thesis onboarded (desk shows de-minimis exposure; refs $41.24/$63.68/$63.68 — at 52W high).

## Risk/Reward ranking (reference levels; longs ranked upside-to-bull ÷ downside-to-bear)

| Rank | Ticker | Side | Price | Bear | Base | Bull | Ref R/R | Note |
|------|--------|------|-------|------|------|------|---------|------|
| 1 | FRMI | long | $5.77 | $4.47 | $7.26 | $15.00 | ~7.1× | Binary; IV crush hitting marks, thesis intact |
| 2 | AAON | long | $83.25 | $71.77 | $87.67 | $148.15 | ~5.6× | RSI 32 + positive MACD = coiled |
| 3 | BRBR | long (calls) | $10.40 | $7.90 | $10.85 | $42.68 | ~13×* | *Bull ref is stale 1Y high — scenario, not target |
| 4 | CTVA | long (calls) | $78.45 | $60.56 | $78.07 | $90.51 | ~0.7× | Worst ref R/R; pure 30-day catalyst bet |
| S1 | DASH | short+puts | $216.00 | $146.60 | $215.79 | $281.74 | squeeze risk | RSI 65 momentum vs 113× PE; $200P floor |
| S2 | LYV | short+puts | ~$180 | $125.61 | $180.74 | $188.46 | tight squeeze zone | 4.7% from fresh 52W high; $165P floor |

**Gemini risk notes (Aug 19):**
- ⚠️ Fighting strong momentum in the DASH and LYV shorts is the primary squeeze risk in a risk-on session.
- ⏳ With 16.1% premium at risk, the book is sensitive to theta decay and sentiment shifts in speculative long-dated holdings (FRMI, BRBR).
- 📉 AAON's post-earnings drift to $83 despite the beat signals a possible negative reversal attracting further selling.

**Engine risk note:** Yesterday's split (GPT 6 / Grok 4 / Fable 8) argued for open-but-sized; today's book already flipped net-short with 95.5% cash — the disagreement hedge is now structural rather than a stance.

*Levels are market references (52W/1Y low · recent close · 52W/1Y high), not intrinsic-value DCFs; confidence low pending refreshed net-DCF work. Catalyst dates unconfirmed except where noted.*
